formatVersion.description: Workbook persistence format. The app migrates older versions at startup and on import, see packages/dashql-app/src/storage/migration.

workbookId.description: Unique workbook identifier (UUID v4). This is the authoritative identity; the storage location prefix is display-only.

workbookPath.description: Display-only path (e.g., "opfs://workbooks/<uuid>" or "fs://<dir>"). Not authoritative and may be absent on newly written workbooks.

storageType.description: Where this workbook's files live. Defaults to "opfs" when omitted.

nativePath.description: Absolute directory holding this workbook's files when storageType is "native".

name.description: User-supplied workbook name shown as the primary label in the workbook bar and selector. Absent (or empty) means the user never named the workbook, and the UI falls back to the display path.

defaultView.description: The view that the workbook opens in, also for the people it is shared with. Optional: absent (or unknown) means the feed, which is never written.

connections.description: The connections that the scripts of the workbook use, in the order the scripts first use them. A workbook without scripts holds the connection its first script will run on. The application's internal compute database is never persisted here.

scripts.description: The scripts of the workbook in feed order. Each entry names a file in scripts/ and the connection the script runs on. Files that are not listed are appended in natural order on load, entries without a file are dropped.

attachments.description: The files in attachments/ in natural order. Lets a workbook served over HTTP be fetched without a directory listing.

WorkbookConnection.description: A connection referenced by the workbook

connectionId.description: The identifier (UUID) of the referenced connection in the connections of the app manifest

params.description: A copy of the saved connection parameters. The app manifest is the source of truth, the copy keeps the workbook folder self-contained.

name.description: The name the user gave the connection. Only exports carry it: an import names the connections that are new to the app after it, the app manifest keeps the names.

paramsDraft.description: Legacy unsaved edits, only read when migrating to global connections. Drafts are kept in the app manifest.

name.description: The file name in scripts/, e.g. "01_extract.sql"

connectionId.description: The connectionId of the connection of the workbook that the script is analyzed and executed with

WorkbookOriginType.description: The origin type of the workbook

ephemeral.description: Is this the workbook of the greeter? It has no scripts and is promoted to a full workbook by its first script

cloud.description: The published workbook of the cloud that this workbook came from or was published to

WorkbookCloudLink.description: A published workbook of the cloud and one of its versions

workbookId.description: The id of the published workbook in the cloud, a UUID

versionId.description: The version that was opened or published last, a UUID

preview.description: Is this a read-only look at the version? The workbook is hidden from the local workbooks until it is imported

connectionId.description: The cloud connection that holds the published workbook
